title: Desktop Intent Request v1
description: Content-light intent request from desktop frontend to backend. All intents are validated against the server-side allowlist before execution.

intent_id.description: Unique identifier for this intent request, generated by the client.

intent_name.description: Name of the intent to execute.

parameters.description: Optional parameters for the intent. Structure depends on intent_name.

dry_run.description: All intents default to dry-run. Protected intents require an authorization_receipt.

projection_seq.description: Optional projection sequence number at time of request.

authorization_receipt.description: Optional step-up authorization receipt for protected intents. Required for Phase 1 protected intents (checkpoint.commit, lease_cleanup.archive). Ignored for safe intents.
